title: After giving Ossett the recovered Companies' banner ('He hangs it on the bare staff himself,' quest 'The Pensioner's Errand' done), every later look/visit to the room and Ossett's own character blurb still read 'a bare banner-staff' / 'a bare banner-staff he polishes anyway,' directly contradicting the delivery that just happened.
